subject: CAIQ artifact staging, owner commitments, and portal access
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <emartinez@northstar.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai; marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: controls@northstar.com
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ follow-up and artifact staging request

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. The InfoSec team at NorthStar ran an initial scan of your CAIQ responses and we have three focused asks before we move to legal: 1) a mapping spreadsheet that ties each CSA control to a named Redwood owner and a reference artifact; 2) short runtime samples for tenant isolation (logs or replay instructions); and 3) temporary portal access to an evidence staging folder for our audit team.

I attached a short workbook with our questions (northstar_caiq_questions_v1.xlsx) — most are clarifying which subcontrol the assertion maps to and where we can pull live snippets. Can you confirm owners and a timeline for delivery? We ideally want a read-only folder by Friday PST.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Security Lead, NorthStar Financial
elena.martinez@northstar.com

[attachment: northstar_caiq_questions_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Elena Martinez <emartinez@northstar.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up and artifact staging request

Elena — thanks for the clear list. We're ready to move quickly on this. High-level plan:

- Owner mapping: we'll produce an annotated CAIQ control matrix (attached: caiq_control_map_v2.xlsx) with a named Redwood owner and a primary artifact link for each control.
- Runtime samples: Karthik will pull two short sanitized log replays showing tenant-boundary enforcement and the autoscaler / tenant routing trace. We will redact PII but preserve headers and control-relevant fields.
- Staging folder: we can provision a read-only S3-backed portal for your team. We'll send access instructions and an expiration of 30 days unless extended.

Can you confirm the minimum set of controls you need in the first pass (full CAIQ vs. critical subset)? If you want the full CAIQ we aim to have the matrix + portal ready by Friday EOD PST; if it's a critical subset (we recommend ~30 controls for scope), we can do it by Thursday.

I'll loop Karthik to own the runtime samples and Marissa to own artifacts and portal provisioning.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0189

Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up and artifact staging request

Adding technical details for the runtime samples:

- Two sanitized captures: (1) tenant-authn-and-routing.log (30s extract) showing token introspection and tenant routing decision; (2) kv-cache-eviction-trace.log (20s) showing cache isolation events across tenant contexts.
- Redaction plan: we will replace tenant IDs with stable pseudonyms (tenant-AA, tenant-BB) and mask IPs; logs will keep timestamps, control-relevant headers (Authorization, x-tenant-id) and decision outcomes.
- Format: plain .log files and a small README that explains mapping to control IDs (CSA-CCM: ID.Management IAM-01, Isolation INF-04).

ETA: Can stage the artifacts into the portal by Thu 16:00 PST if we get portal creds today. Otherwise Friday morning.

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
